_metadata.source: TOP NeurIPS 2023 supplementary, Figure 4 (bag descriptive prompts, TCGA Lung Cancer subtyping)

prompts.LUAD: A subtype of non-small cell lung cancer, lung adenocarcinoma is characterized by the presence of glandular structures, mucin production, and lepidic growth patterns.
prompts.LUSC: Another subtype of non-small cell lung cancer. It is characterized by the presence of keratinization, intercellular bridges, and large, polygonal-shaped cells.
